description: This is the main entry point for a React frontend application. It imports React, ReactDOM, a CSS stylesheet, and the main App component. It initializes the React rendering by creating a root and rendering the App component inside React.StrictMode.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React root for rendering the React component tree.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the DOM node.
